title: TN India Job Collector
description: Collects recent India job postings from employer feeds, LinkedIn, and Naukri. Results from Tamil Nadu are shown first.

enableLinkedInJobs.title: Collect LinkedIn jobs
enableLinkedInJobs.description: Runs the paid LinkedIn Jobs Scraper Actor for Tamil Nadu and India. Each search is capped by the external result limit.

enableNaukriJobs.title: Collect Naukri jobs
enableNaukriJobs.description: Runs the paid Naukri Job Scraper Actor for Tamil Nadu and India. Each search is capped by the external result limit.

externalSearchKeyword.title: External job search keyword
externalSearchKeyword.description: Optional keyword or job role used by LinkedIn and Naukri. Leave empty for broad searches.

maxExternalJobsPerSearch.title: Maximum external jobs per search
maxExternalJobsPerSearch.description: Maximum results requested per location search from each paid Store Actor. Two searches (Tamil Nadu and India) are run per enabled Actor.

maxExternalChargePerSearchUsd.title: Maximum Store Actor charge per search (USD)
maxExternalChargePerSearchUsd.description: Per-run Apify charge cap passed to each LinkedIn or Naukri child run. Four searches may run when both sources are enabled.

greenhouseBoards.title: Greenhouse company boards
greenhouseBoards.description: Add company board tokens as JSON. Example: [{"token":"company-token","company":"Company Name"}]

smartRecruitersCompanies.title: SmartRecruiters companies
smartRecruitersCompanies.description: Add company identifiers as JSON. Example: [{"identifier":"Freshworks","company":"Freshworks"}]

targetLocations.title: Target locations
targetLocations.description: Only jobs whose listed location contains one of these values will be collected. The default includes India-wide results; Tamil Nadu jobs are sorted first.

collectAllLocations.title: Collect all locations
collectAllLocations.description: Use only for testing a source. When enabled, location filtering is skipped.

keywords.title: Job keywords
keywords.description: Leave empty to collect all jobs matching the target locations. Add role keywords later to filter titles and locations.

maxJobsPerBoard.title: Maximum jobs per company
maxJobsPerBoard.description: Limits recent jobs collected from each Greenhouse or SmartRecruiters company.
